about: The five listings an external router (Tenjin) reported live but hidden or mislabelled by the GET-only prober, plus the first-party family the catalog operator measured the same day, measured 2026-10-01 against v2.46.1 with unpaid probes. Shapes only: no test calls these hosts. `seller` is how each origin answers an unpaid request per method, served by a local test server. `reported` is the label the catalog carried. `provenance` says which parts are captured and which are modelled.

cases.name: tavily-search
cases.provenance: Listing captured verbatim from the Coinbase CDP feed (cdp-pricing-page.json, 2026-09-10), including its agent-pay option whose payTo is a quote reference, not an address. The GET answer is modelled: quarantine takes three fail-class probes, and 404 is the dominant one.

cases.name: glim-twitter-search
cases.provenance: URL and method from the report. Example body, amount and payTo are illustrative; the GET answer is modelled as for tavily-search.

cases.name: bitrefill-invoice-create
cases.provenance: URL and method from the report. Example body, amount and payTo are illustrative; the GET answer is modelled as for tavily-search.

cases.name: losbeto-stock-quote
cases.provenance: URL and the live GET from the report (all 87 listings of the host quarantined, GET /stock-quote answering 402). Query parameters, amount and payTo are illustrative. The report does not say why the family is quarantined, and a live GET means the method is not the cause: this case pins that the change leaves a GET listing on the ordinary hysteresis.

cases.name: tenjin-phone-lookup
cases.provenance: URL and both answers measured in the report (GET 405, POST 402). Whether the listing declares a method is not known; it is modelled with no declaration, the case only the fallback can find. Amount and payTo are illustrative.

cases.name: meshrelay-payments-access
cases.provenance: Not in the report: measured by the catalog operator on 2026-10-02 -- the 7 first-party listings under this prefix (config/bazaar_curation.json) quarantined with a last GET of 404, the default answer of an Express app to a method it has no route for. The POST 402 is modelled from that service's source; the path and amount are illustrative, the payTo is the one the curation manifest expects. No method declared: only the fallback can find it, and only if it covers a 404.
